source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. This page displays the list of event logs occurred by the different sensors on this device.
2. Check system and audit log
3. Click "Save Logs" button to export the event logs.
4. Click "Clear All Logs" button to clear the event logs.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. all info correct
2. all message should match status
3. SEL should be exported successfully.
4. SEL should be cleared successfully.

This review retains that classification while making the Master conflict explicit: Procedure says system and audit logs, but export/clear wording and Criteria name event logs/SEL, so each selected service and destructive scope must be separately approved and evidenced.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 858/2291 accepts the malformed/truncated read-only command as agent-direct and ignores both required WebUI operations, destructive evidence loss, credential exposure and the unresolved system-versus-audit-versus-SEL scope.

original_test_intent: Verify the BMC System Event Logs page presents sensor event messages with correct status, can export the complete intended log set through `Save Logs`, and can clear the approved log scope through `Clear All Logs`; the preserved source additionally says to check audit logs but Criteria name only SEL, so those service scopes must remain distinct.
original_method: The source orders a blanket pre-test clear, then checks system/audit logs, exports event logs and clears them again. The Review-layer method preserves that wording but first resolves SEL/system-event versus audit-log scope, forbids the blanket pre-clear, captures and validates a complete baseline/export, then—only on an approved lab target and after separate explicit confirmation—invokes the exact Clear All Logs control once and proves the selected service alone reached its defined cleared state.
manual_activity: The engineer selects which system-event/SEL and audit services are viewed, exported and eligible for deletion, approves a disposable lab target and retention exception, verifies the backup, and explicitly authorizes the one-time clear. Automation may collect, export, compare and invoke the approved UI action; the end user owns the destructive scope and final verdict.
required_inputs: Exact BMC endpoint/certificate, controller firmware/WebUI build and account role
Authoritative map of System Event/SEL and Audit log services, including which are view-only, exported by Save Logs and targeted by Clear All Logs
Expected sensor/event message, status, severity, timestamp/timezone, sequence/order, filter, pagination, capacity/overflow and cleared-state rules
Export filename, MIME/container, encoding, schema/columns, full-scope behavior, parser and secure storage/checksum/retention policy
Approved lab/maintenance window, evidence-retention authority, exact one-time clear control/API semantics and proof that protected security/audit services remain untouched
Protected IPMI/API/UI authentication, validated tool versions, alternative OOB path and incident/recovery procedure for wrong-scope deletion
safety_requirements: Do not perform the source's blanket pre-test clear. It would erase the events needed to validate messages/export and gives no safe definition of which system, audit or SEL stores are affected.
Do not clear any log until the full selected scope is exported, parsed, checksummed, stored under the approved retention policy and independently verified complete.
Do not infer that System Event Log, SEL and audit log are interchangeable. Resolve each backing service and make view, export and clear eligibility explicit before execution.

Do not use the DeepSeek command: avoid `sel list system`, truncation with `head -50`, `-P` password exposure and generic output that omits UI/export/clear checkpoints. Validate tool syntax and exit status on the approved platform.

Clear All Logs is destructive and irreversible on many BMCs. Require the dedicated target, maintenance window, exact UI/service identity, explicit pre-execution `OK`, one invocation and a post-state check; never retry automatically.

Stop if backup completeness, retention authority, clear scope, protected audit/security-log separation, target identity or recovery cannot be proven. Preserve all action/audit evidence and never fabricate cleared entries.
agent_execution_scope: Discover and label the SEL/system-event and audit services, capture complete baseline metadata/entries across pagination and correlate sensor messages/statuses with the WebUI without deleting anything.
Invoke Save Logs once for the approved scope, quarantine/hash/parse the file and reconcile stable entry IDs, counts and time boundaries with the pre-clear baseline.

Present the exact target, irreversible clear operation, verified backup and stop conditions; only after explicit approval invoke Clear All Logs once on the approved service and verify the specified cleared marker/count plus preservation of excluded services.
Retain export and audit evidence, report any concurrent entries or partial clear without retry, and never issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve whether Procedure's audit-log check is view-only, separately exported/cleared or erroneous relative to the SEL-only Criteria, while preserving the Master conflict.
Approve message/status mapping, complete export contract, destructive target, retention exception, maintenance window and wrong-scope recovery/escalation.
Review view correctness, export completeness and clear-scope evidence as separate checkpoints, then issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit. It is read-only while the source requires Save Logs and Clear All Logs; its syntax is dubious, truncates one output, may expose passwords and cannot prove UI, audit-service, export or post-clear behavior. No part authorizes destructive execution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved WebUI Save Logs and Clear All Logs controls for the engineer-selected service scope, with vendor-supported read-only API/ipmitool queries only for complete before/after correlation. Export and validate first; request separate explicit approval immediately before the single clear; confirm excluded services remain intact.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The system/audit wording, Save Logs, Clear All Logs, SEL Criteria, absent Script and 10/0-minute estimates remain preserved as source facts; the Review layer separates their scopes and rejects blanket pre-clearing without editing them.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Model the case as three gated checkpoints—viewer/status correctness, complete export, and destructive clear—against explicitly named log services. Freeze only the evidence snapshot, not the live log; validate export; then execute one authorized clear and verify exact service isolation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the designated non-production/lab BMC whose WebUI/log-service mapping, retention authority and recovery have been approved.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware/WebUI build, LogService/entry schema or vendor log identifiers and ipmitool/client versions because service names and clear semantics vary.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor System Event/SEL and Audit Log UI/export/clear documentation, DMTF Redfish LogService/LogEntry model where applicable, IPMI SEL behavior and Project evidence-retention policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves export and clear functionality but removes unsafe blanket pre-clearing, resolves service identities, validates the export before deletion and protects excluded audit/security evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only listing validates no export or clear function; exporting SEL does not prove audit export; clearing one service does not prove another; post-clear emptiness does not prove the backup is complete or recoverable.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Service/scope decision, message matrix, export/parser/retention contract, destructive approval, lab target, protected access and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Clearing can irreversibly erase incident history and other-test evidence; live logs may append during the sequence; some BMC buttons can clear multiple stores despite a single page label.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use vendor API/CLI equivalents for export or clear only with recorded original UI method, actual tool/action, reason, engineer approval, equivalent service scope and proof of excluded-log preservation. It may omit destructive clear for a protected environment, but must mark that original functional coverage unverified rather than claiming read-only PASS.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/controller, firmware/WebUI build, trusted certificate, account role and discovered SEL/system-event/audit service map
Signed decision listing viewer, Save Logs and Clear All Logs scope separately plus protected/excluded services and retention authorization
Complete pre-clear entries/metadata across pages with sensor/status/timestamp/sequence/capacity context and redacted WebUI comparison
Save Logs download origin, filename, MIME/container, size, checksum, parser result and stable entry/count/time-bound completeness reconciliation
Explicit approval record and exact single clear request/response, before/after count or clear marker, new post-clear boundary and proof excluded audit/security services were preserved
Protected command/action audit, no automatic retry, recovery/escalation record, coverage limitations and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure says to check both system and audit logs and uses generic `event logs`/`Clear All Logs`, while Criteria require only SEL export and clearing; the Before-Test blanket clear also conflicts with later validation/export of messages. The core viewer/export/clear functions remain identifiable, but their destructive service scope must be resolved in the Review layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The three operations are identifiable and can be safely planned once the Project names the target log services, retention policy and destructive scope. These are execution-readiness/engineer-approval inputs, so the row remains PACKAGE rather than permanently BLOCKED; execution must stop until they are supplied.

review_improvement: Prevents a truncated read-only command from falsely satisfying export/clear requirements, prevents unverified backup from preceding deletion and prevents a generic Clear All control from silently erasing audit or security evidence outside the intended SEL scope.
independent_technical_reasoning: Viewer, export and clear are distinct functions with escalating risk. Correct viewer evidence needs decoded sensor/status mapping; export needs complete file validation; clear needs irreversible-target governance and after-state isolation. Because the source names system, audit, event and SEL inconsistently, a safe plan must bind every checkpoint to a concrete service before any deletion, while retaining rather than hiding the original conflict.
